name: io.github.sepehr071/raja-mcp
title: Raja Train Tickets
description: Read-only Raja (raja.ir) Iranian trains: stations, search with prices and seats, timetables, news.

environmentVariables.name: RAJA_MCP_PROXY
environmentVariables.description: Optional HTTP proxy URL for the Raja requests; system proxy settings are ignored. Also accepts a comma-separated list: one is used until it gets blocked or fails to connect, then the next.
